content:
Hi all, welcome!

If you have completed a formalization of any serious mathematics, by hand or with AI, it can be contributed to Lean Pool. Your project needs to compile and it needs to be a completed project. It will be maintained in Lean Pool, and others can build their mathematics on top of your mathematics. The original repo and author(s) are credited.
The easiest way is to contribute is tell your AI to open a PR. Or you can open an Issue and I'll have my AI open the PR for you. There are some hoops to jump through that help with ensuring reasonable quality but AI can jump through them

My ultimate hope for Lean Pool is that when you prove some math, and then formalize it in Lean, you would upload the formalization to Lean Pool and add a link in the arXiv paper. Then when someone builds their math on top your math, they'll be able to build their formalization on top of yours. We'll know that the code in Lean Pool is useful because it allows us to formalize serious mathematics, even if it's not as high quality as hand-curated libraries (similar to how arXiv is lower quality than math journals but is immensely useful).

Let's pool our Lean together!
